reasoning: The agent goes well past a happy-path smoke test: it boots via start.sh, confirms health, drives the service through the real stripe SDK (step 99), and builds targeted tests for two of the three named trip-up subsystems — webhook retry/backoff/re-signing (92) and concurrent same-key idempotency serialization (97) — plus config-env-var checks (107), which touches the anchor-10 timing dimension. That clearly clears anchor 5 and satisfies the core of anchor 8. It falls short of 9-10 because the checks are one-off bash scripts rather than a continuously-run harness treated as source of truth, and there is no visible evidence of the mismatched-body idempotency_error case, replay-of-original-error-body, or the PaymentIntent capture-on-succeeded state-machine rejection being explicitly exercised.
